topic: Fresh confirmation of the Pucks anonymous-checkout shipping quote for the tracked Crema e Gusto 250 g listing
method: Interactive headless Google Chrome 154 + ChromeDriver 154 through scripts/browser-research.mjs. One anonymous cart was built by adding 2 x 250 g of the tracked listing to the public cart; the public checkout estimator at https://pucks.co.il/payment/request was read with only the locality and postcode fields filled (Tel Aviv / 6100000). No name, phone, email, street or building number was entered; no order, payment, login or account was submitted; no bot challenge or access control was bypassed. Cart/session identifiers, cookies and tokens are not recorded.
toolingLimitation: The available file-read tool rejects PNG input ('reading images is not supported'), so the screenshot cannot be machine-inspected by the model; the quote below is backed by the rendered DOM text captured through the same live session. The screenshot is kept as an artifact for a human reviewer.
